events.text: Worker secrets show no Kie/GHL/Instantly/Google client. Now checking whether the centre's `drive_client_id` setting holds the Email Campaign client (boolean compare, no values printed).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare centre drive client setting to the env file
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; DB=$(command grep -oE '"database_name": *"[^"]+"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*: *"//;s/"//'); echo "db=$DB"; for m in --local --remote; do npx wrangler d1 execute "$DB" $m --json --command "SELECT key, value FROM settings WHERE key IN ('drive_client_id')" 2>/dev/null > /tmp/t302-$m.json; python3 - "$m" <<'EOF'
